questions.q: Who made the heavens and the earth?
questions.exp: “In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.” (Genesis 1:1)

questions.q: What did God make on the very first day?
questions.exp: God said, “Let there be light”: and there was light. (Genesis 1:3–5)

questions.q: On which day did God rest?
questions.exp: God rested on the seventh day and blessed it. (Genesis 2:2–3)

questions.q: Who was the first man God made?
questions.exp: God formed man from the dust and called him Adam. (Genesis 2:7, 2:20)

questions.q: What was the name of the first woman?
questions.exp: Adam called his wife Eve, the mother of all living. (Genesis 3:20)

questions.q: In which garden did Adam and Eve live?
questions.exp: God planted a garden eastward in Eden. (Genesis 2:8)

questions.q: Which animal tricked Eve in the garden?
questions.exp: The serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field. (Genesis 3:1)

questions.q: Who built a big ark to save his family from the flood?
questions.exp: God told Noah, “Make thee an ark of gopher wood.” (Genesis 6:14)

questions.q: How did the animals go into the ark?
questions.exp: They went in two and two unto Noah into the ark. (Genesis 7:9)

questions.q: What did God put in the sky as a promise after the flood?
questions.exp: God set His bow in the cloud as a sign of His promise. (Genesis 9:13)

questions.q: Which bird came back to Noah with an olive leaf?
questions.exp: The dove came back with an olive leaf in her mouth. (Genesis 8:11)

questions.q: Who were Adam and Eve's first two sons?
questions.exp: Eve bare Cain, and then his brother Abel. (Genesis 4:1–2)

questions.q: For how many days and nights did it rain in the flood?
questions.exp: The rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights. (Genesis 7:12)

questions.q: On which mountains did Noah's ark come to rest?
questions.exp: The ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat. (Genesis 8:4)

questions.q: What were the names of Noah's three sons?
questions.exp: Noah begat three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Genesis 6:10)

questions.q: On which day did God make the sun, moon and stars?
questions.exp: The greater light, the lesser light and the stars were made on the fourth day. (Genesis 1:14–19)

questions.q: What did Abel offer to God?
questions.exp: Abel brought the firstlings of his flock; Cain brought fruit of the ground. (Genesis 4:3–4)

questions.q: Which son of Adam was born after Abel died?
questions.exp: Eve bare a son and called his name Seth. (Genesis 4:25)

questions.q: Who “walked with God: and he was not; for God took him”?
questions.exp: Enoch walked with God, and God took him. (Genesis 5:24)

questions.q: How old was Methuselah when he died, the longest life in the Bible?
questions.exp: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years. (Genesis 5:27)

questions.q: Where did God confuse the people's language?
questions.exp: Therefore is the name of it called Babel. (Genesis 11:9)

questions.q: Who was called “a mighty hunter before the LORD”?
questions.exp: Nimrod was a mighty hunter before the LORD. (Genesis 10:9)

questions.q: How many people were saved in Noah's ark?
questions.exp: Few, that is, eight souls were saved by water. (1 Peter 3:20)

questions.q: What wood was Noah told to build the ark from?
questions.exp: Make thee an ark of gopher wood. (Genesis 6:14)

questions.q: How old was Noah when the flood came?
questions.exp: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth. (Genesis 7:6)

questions.q: God promised Abraham children as many as the…
questions.exp: Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars… So shall thy seed be. (Genesis 15:5)

questions.q: What was the name of Abraham and Sarah's son?
questions.exp: Sarah bare Abraham a son, and he called him Isaac. (Genesis 21:2–3)

questions.q: Who had a coat of many colours?
questions.exp: Israel made Joseph a coat of many colours. (Genesis 37:3)

questions.q: What did Joseph's brothers do to him?
questions.exp: They sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver. (Genesis 37:28)

questions.q: Which twin brother sold his birthright for a bowl of stew?
questions.exp: Esau sold his birthright unto Jacob for bread and pottage. (Genesis 25:33–34)

questions.q: Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching up to heaven. Who went up and down on it?
questions.exp: The angels of God were ascending and descending on it. (Genesis 28:12)

questions.q: How many sons did Jacob have?
questions.exp: Now the sons of Jacob were twelve. (Genesis 35:22)

questions.q: In which land did Joseph become a great ruler?
questions.exp: Pharaoh set Joseph over all the land of Egypt. (Genesis 41:41)

questions.q: How old was Abraham when Isaac was born?
questions.exp: Abraham was an hundred years old when Isaac was born. (Genesis 21:5)

questions.q: What did God give Abraham to offer instead of Isaac?
questions.exp: Abraham looked, and behold a ram caught in a thicket by his horns. (Genesis 22:13)

questions.q: Joseph could tell what dreams meant. Whose dreams did he explain in prison?
questions.exp: Joseph explained the dreams of the butler and the baker. (Genesis 40)

questions.q: What was Abraham's name before God changed it?
questions.exp: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but… Abraham. (Genesis 17:5)

questions.q: From which city did Abram set out?
questions.exp: They went forth from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. (Genesis 11:31)

questions.q: Who was Isaac's wife?
questions.exp: Isaac took Rebekah, and she became his wife. (Genesis 24:67)

questions.q: What new name did God give Jacob after he wrestled until dawn?
questions.exp: Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel. (Genesis 32:28)

questions.q: Which two sisters did Jacob marry?
questions.exp: Laban gave Jacob Leah and then Rachel. (Genesis 29)

questions.q: Who was Joseph's younger full brother?
questions.exp: Rachel's sons were Joseph and Benjamin. (Genesis 35:24)

questions.q: What did Pharaoh dream about, which Joseph explained?
opts: Seven fat and seven thin cows
questions.exp: Seven well favoured kine and seven ill favoured kine. (Genesis 41:1–7)

questions.q: For how many pieces of silver was Joseph sold?
questions.exp: They sold Joseph for twenty pieces of silver. (Genesis 37:28)

questions.q: What happened to Lot's wife when she looked back at Sodom?
opts: She became a pillar of salt
questions.exp: She became a pillar of salt. (Genesis 19:26)

questions.q: Which priest-king of Salem blessed Abram with bread and wine?
questions.exp: Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine. (Genesis 14:18)

questions.q: Who was the mother of Ishmael?
questions.exp: Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name Ishmael. (Genesis 16:15)

questions.q: In which cave were Abraham and Sarah buried?
questions.exp: Abraham buried Sarah in the cave of the field of Machpelah. (Genesis 23:19)

questions.q: Where was baby Moses hidden?
opts: In a basket by the river
questions.exp: His mother laid him in an ark of bulrushes by the river's brink. (Exodus 2:3)

questions.q: Who found baby Moses in the river?
questions.exp: The daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash and saw the ark. (Exodus 2:5)

questions.q: God spoke to Moses from a bush that was…
opts: On fire but not burnt up
questions.exp: The bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed. (Exodus 3:2)

questions.q: What sea did God part so the Israelites could walk through?
questions.exp: The children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground. (Exodus 14:22)

questions.q: What food fell from heaven in the wilderness?
questions.exp: The house of Israel called the name thereof Manna. (Exodus 16:31)

questions.q: How many commandments did God give Moses?
questions.exp: He wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments. (Exodus 34:28)

questions.q: On which mountain did God give the Ten Commandments?
questions.exp: The LORD came down upon mount Sinai. (Exodus 19:20)

questions.q: Who was Moses' brother who spoke for him?
questions.exp: Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? He shall be thy spokesman. (Exodus 4:14–16)

questions.q: How many plagues did God send on Egypt?
questions.exp: Egypt suffered ten plagues, ending with the death of the firstborn. (Exodus 7–12)

questions.q: What did the Israelites make and worship while Moses was on the mountain?
questions.exp: Aaron made it a molten calf. (Exodus 32:4)

questions.q: What did Moses' staff turn into in front of Pharaoh?
questions.exp: Aaron cast down his rod… and it became a serpent. (Exodus 7:10)

questions.q: What was the first plague on Egypt?
questions.exp: All the waters that were in the river were turned to blood. (Exodus 7:20)

questions.q: What was the last and worst plague?
questions.exp: The LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt. (Exodus 12:29)

questions.q: Who was Moses' father-in-law?
questions.exp: Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law. (Exodus 3:1)

questions.q: For how many years did Israel wander in the wilderness?
questions.exp: Your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years. (Numbers 14:33)

questions.q: Who held up Moses' hands during the battle with Amalek?
questions.exp: Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands. (Exodus 17:12)

questions.q: What name did God give Himself to Moses at the burning bush?
questions.exp: God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM. (Exodus 3:14)

questions.q: Which two spies gave a good report of Canaan?
questions.exp: Joshua and Caleb said the land is an exceeding good land. (Numbers 14:6–7)

questions.q: What did Moses lift up so that people bitten by serpents could live?
questions.exp: Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole. (Numbers 21:9)

questions.q: Whose donkey spoke to him on the road?
questions.exp: The LORD opened the mouth of the ass. (Numbers 22:28)

questions.q: What feast remembers the night the Lord passed over Israel's houses?
questions.exp: It is the LORD's passover. (Exodus 12:11)

questions.q: From which mountain did Moses see the Promised Land before he died?
questions.exp: Moses went up unto the mountain of Nebo… and the LORD shewed him all the land. (Deuteronomy 34:1)

questions.q: What were the two stone tablets kept inside?
questions.exp: Thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee. (Exodus 25:16)

questions.q: Which city's walls fell down when the people shouted?
questions.exp: The people shouted… and the wall fell down flat. (Joshua 6:20)

questions.q: Who beat the giant Goliath?
questions.exp: David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone. (1 Samuel 17:50)

questions.q: What did David use to beat Goliath?
questions.exp: David took a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine. (1 Samuel 17:49)

questions.q: Which strong man's power was linked to his long hair?
questions.exp: If I be shaven, then my strength will go from me. (Judges 16:17)

questions.q: What job did young David do before he became king?
questions.exp: David kept his father's sheep. (1 Samuel 17:15)

questions.q: Which wise king built a great temple for God?
questions.exp: Solomon built the house of the LORD. (1 Kings 6)

questions.q: Who was the first king of Israel?
questions.exp: Samuel anointed Saul to be captain over Israel. (1 Samuel 10:1)

questions.q: Young Samuel heard God calling him at night. What did he answer?
questions.exp: Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth. (1 Samuel 3:10)

questions.q: What did Solomon ask God for?
questions.exp: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart. (1 Kings 3:9)

questions.q: David played music for King Saul. What instrument did he play?
questions.exp: David took an harp, and played with his hand. (1 Samuel 16:23)

questions.q: Who was David's best friend?
questions.exp: The soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David. (1 Samuel 18:1)

questions.q: Who led Israel into the Promised Land after Moses?
questions.exp: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise… thou, and all this people. (Joshua 1:2)

questions.q: With how many men did Gideon defeat the Midianites?
questions.exp: By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you. (Judges 7:7)

questions.q: Who was the only woman judge of Israel named in the book of Judges?
questions.exp: Deborah, a prophetess… judged Israel at that time. (Judges 4:4)

questions.q: Who said to Naomi, “Whither thou goest, I will go”?
questions.exp: Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave thee… whither thou goest, I will go. (Ruth 1:16)

questions.q: Whom did Ruth marry?
questions.exp: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife. (Ruth 4:13)

questions.q: Who anointed David as king while he was still a boy?
questions.exp: Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him. (1 Samuel 16:13)

questions.q: Which prophet told David the story of the poor man's lamb?
questions.exp: The LORD sent Nathan unto David… Thou art the man. (2 Samuel 12:1–7)

questions.q: Which son of David rebelled and was caught by his hair in a tree?
questions.exp: His head caught hold of the oak. (2 Samuel 18:9)

questions.q: Which queen visited Solomon to test him with hard questions?
questions.exp: She came to prove him with hard questions. (1 Kings 10:1)

questions.q: How tall was Goliath, according to the King James Version?
questions.exp: Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span. (1 Samuel 17:4)

questions.q: After Solomon, the kingdom split. What was the northern kingdom called?
questions.exp: Ten tribes followed Jeroboam as Israel; Judah stayed with Rehoboam. (1 Kings 12)

questions.q: Which people were Samson's great enemies?
questions.exp: The lords of the Philistines came up unto Delilah. (Judges 16:5)

questions.q: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
questions.exp: The LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. (Jonah 1:17)

questions.q: How long was Jonah inside the fish?
questions.exp: Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights. (Jonah 1:17)

questions.q: Who was thrown into a den of lions but was not hurt?
questions.exp: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths. (Daniel 6:22)

questions.q: Which birds brought food to Elijah by the brook?
questions.exp: The ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning. (1 Kings 17:6)

questions.q: How did Elijah go up to heaven?
opts: In a whirlwind with a chariot of fire
questions.exp: Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven. (2 Kings 2:11)

questions.q: Which three friends were thrown into a fiery furnace?
questions.exp: They did not burn; a fourth man walked with them in the fire. (Daniel 3:25)

questions.q: Why was Daniel thrown to the lions?
questions.exp: Daniel kneeled three times a day and prayed. (Daniel 6:10)

questions.q: Which brave queen saved her people from wicked Haman?
questions.exp: Who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this? (Esther 4:14)

questions.q: To which city did God send Jonah?
questions.exp: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city. (Jonah 1:2)

questions.q: Who took Elijah's place as prophet?
questions.exp: Elijah cast his mantle upon Elisha. (1 Kings 19:19)

questions.q: Which king built a big gold statue and said everyone must bow down to it?
questions.exp: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold. (Daniel 3:1)

questions.q: On which mountain did Elijah face the prophets of Baal?
questions.exp: Gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel. (1 Kings 18:19)

questions.q: Which wicked queen was married to King Ahab?
questions.exp: Ahab took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal. (1 Kings 16:31)

questions.q: Which Syrian captain was healed of leprosy by washing in the Jordan seven times?
questions.exp: His flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child. (2 Kings 5:14)

questions.q: What words appeared on the wall at Belshazzar's feast?
questions.exp: This is the writing that was written: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN. (Daniel 5:25)

questions.q: Which prophet saw a valley of dry bones come to life?
questions.exp: O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD. (Ezekiel 37:4)

questions.q: Which prophet is called “the weeping prophet”?
questions.exp: Oh that… mine eyes [were] a fountain of tears. (Jeremiah 9:1)

questions.q: Who rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem in 52 days?
questions.exp: So the wall was finished… in fifty and two days. (Nehemiah 6:15)

questions.q: Which prophet wrote, “unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given”?
questions.exp: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given. (Isaiah 9:6)

questions.q: Which prophet foretold that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem?
questions.exp: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah… out of thee shall he come forth. (Micah 5:2)

questions.q: What was Daniel's Babylonian name?
questions.exp: Unto Daniel he gave the name of Belteshazzar. (Daniel 1:7)

questions.q: What was Esther's Hebrew name?
questions.exp: He brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther. (Esther 2:7)

questions.q: What plant did God grow to shade Jonah outside Nineveh?
questions.exp: The LORD God prepared a gourd… that it might be a shadow over his head. (Jonah 4:6)

questions.q: For how many years did Jeremiah say Judah would serve Babylon?
questions.exp: These nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years. (Jeremiah 25:11)

questions.q: Finish the verse: “The LORD is my…”
questions.exp: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. (Psalm 23:1)

questions.q: Who wrote many of the Psalms?
questions.exp: Many Psalms are titled “A Psalm of David”, the sweet psalmist of Israel. (2 Samuel 23:1)

questions.q: Psalm 119:105 says God's word is a lamp unto my…
questions.exp: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path. (Psalm 119:105)

questions.q: What does Psalm 150 tell everything that has breath to do?
questions.exp: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. (Psalm 150:6)

questions.q: Which tiny animal does Proverbs tell lazy people to learn from?
questions.exp: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise. (Proverbs 6:6)

questions.q: “This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will…”
opts: Rejoice and be glad in it
questions.exp: We will rejoice and be glad in it. (Psalm 118:24)

questions.q: Who wrote most of the book of Proverbs?
questions.exp: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel. (Proverbs 1:1)

questions.q: “A soft answer turneth away…”
questions.exp: A soft answer turneth away wrath. (Proverbs 15:1)

questions.q: How many Psalms are in the Bible?
questions.exp: The book of Psalms has 150 psalms.

questions.q: Proverbs says, “Train up a child in the way he should…”
questions.exp: Train up a child in the way he should go. (Proverbs 22:6)

questions.q: In Psalm 23, the Good Shepherd leads me beside the still…
questions.exp: He leadeth me beside the still waters. (Psalm 23:2)

questions.q: “The fear of the LORD is the beginning of…”
questions.exp: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge. (Proverbs 1:7)

questions.q: “Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto…”
questions.exp: Lean not unto thine own understanding. (Proverbs 3:5)

questions.q: Which is the longest Psalm (and longest chapter in the Bible)?
questions.exp: Psalm 119 has 176 verses.

questions.q: Which is the shortest Psalm (and shortest chapter in the Bible)?
questions.exp: Psalm 117 has only two verses.

questions.q: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of…”
questions.exp: Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. (Psalm 91:1)

questions.q: Which Psalm did David write after Nathan confronted him about Bathsheba?
questions.exp: “Create in me a clean heart, O God.” Psalm 51 is titled for that moment. (Psalm 51:10)

questions.q: Proverbs 31 describes a…
questions.exp: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies. (Proverbs 31:10)

questions.q: “Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before…”
questions.exp: An haughty spirit before a fall. (Proverbs 16:18)

questions.q: Which book says “To every thing there is a season”?
questions.exp: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose. (Ecclesiastes 3:1)

questions.q: Which man lost everything but said, “the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away”?
questions.exp: Blessed be the name of the LORD. (Job 1:21)

questions.q: Psalm 22 begins with words Jesus cried on the cross. Which?
opts: Into thy hands I commend my spirit
My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
questions.exp: Psalm 22:1; Jesus cried these words in Matthew 27:46.

questions.q: Who is named as the writer of Psalm 90?
questions.exp: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. (Psalm 90, title)

questions.q: “Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his…”
questions.exp: So a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend. (Proverbs 27:17)

questions.q: In which town was Jesus born?
questions.exp: Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea. (Matthew 2:1)

questions.q: Who was the mother of Jesus?
questions.exp: Mary… of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ. (Matthew 1:16)

questions.q: Where was baby Jesus laid after He was born?
questions.exp: She laid him in a manger; because there was no room in the inn. (Luke 2:7)

questions.q: What guided the wise men to Jesus?
questions.exp: The star… went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was. (Matthew 2:9)

questions.q: Which angel told Mary she would have a baby?
questions.exp: The angel Gabriel was sent from God… to a virgin… Mary. (Luke 1:26–27)

questions.q: What was Joseph's job?
questions.exp: Is not this the carpenter's son? (Matthew 13:55)

questions.q: How many disciples did Jesus choose to be His apostles?
questions.exp: He ordained twelve, that they should be with him. (Mark 3:14)

questions.q: Who baptized Jesus?
questions.exp: Then cometh Jesus… to John, to be baptized of him. (Matthew 3:13)

questions.q: What came down like a dove when Jesus was baptized?
questions.exp: He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove. (Matthew 3:16)

questions.q: Who heard the angels sing on the night Jesus was born?
questions.exp: There were… shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock. (Luke 2:8)

questions.q: Which gifts did the wise men bring?
questions.exp: They presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh. (Matthew 2:11)

questions.q: Which disciple was a tax collector?
questions.exp: He saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom. (Matthew 9:9)

questions.q: In which town did Jesus grow up?
questions.exp: He came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth. (Matthew 2:23)

questions.q: How old was Jesus when He was found teaching in the temple?
questions.exp: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem. (Luke 2:42)

questions.q: For how many days was Jesus tempted in the wilderness?
questions.exp: Being forty days tempted of the devil. (Luke 4:2)

questions.q: To which country did Joseph take Mary and Jesus to escape Herod?
questions.exp: Take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt. (Matthew 2:13)

questions.q: Who was the cousin of Mary and mother of John the Baptist?
questions.exp: Thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son. (Luke 1:36)

questions.q: Which old man in the temple held baby Jesus and praised God?
questions.exp: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace. (Luke 2:25–29)

questions.q: Which two brothers were fishermen called “sons of thunder”?
questions.exp: He surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder. (Mark 3:17)

questions.q: Which Pharisee came to Jesus by night and was told he must be born again?
questions.exp: Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. (John 3:3)

questions.q: How old was Jesus when He began His ministry, according to Luke?
questions.exp: Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age. (Luke 3:23)

questions.q: Which Roman emperor ordered the census when Jesus was born?
questions.exp: There went out a decree from Caesar Augustus. (Luke 2:1)

questions.q: What does “Emmanuel” mean?
questions.exp: They shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us. (Matthew 1:23)

questions.q: Which disciple, brought by Philip, asked “Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth?”
questions.exp: Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? (John 1:46)

questions.q: What did Jesus turn water into at a wedding?
questions.exp: The water that was made wine. (John 2:9)

questions.q: How many people did Jesus feed with five loaves and two fish?
questions.exp: They that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children. (Matthew 14:21)

questions.q: Who gave the five loaves and two fish?
questions.exp: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes. (John 6:9)

questions.q: What did Jesus walk on?
questions.exp: Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea. (Matthew 14:25)

questions.q: What did Jesus say to the stormy sea?
questions.exp: He arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. (Mark 4:39)

questions.q: Which friend of Jesus did He raise from the dead after four days?
questions.exp: Lazarus, come forth. (John 11:43)

questions.q: Which disciple walked on water toward Jesus, then began to sink?
questions.exp: Peter… walked on the water… but when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid. (Matthew 14:29–30)

questions.q: How many baskets of leftovers were picked up after feeding the 5,000?
questions.exp: They took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full. (Matthew 14:20)

questions.q: How did the friends of a sick man get him to Jesus in a crowded house?
questions.exp: They uncovered the roof… they let down the bed. (Mark 2:4)

questions.q: How many lepers did Jesus heal when only one came back to say thank you?
questions.exp: Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? (Luke 17:17)

questions.q: Jesus healed a man who was born…
questions.exp: He spat on the ground, made clay… and he came seeing. (John 9:6–7)

questions.q: In which town was the wedding where Jesus did His first miracle?
questions.exp: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee. (John 2:11)

questions.q: Whose 12-year-old daughter did Jesus raise, saying “Talitha cumi”?
questions.exp: Talitha cumi; which is… Damsel, I say unto thee, arise. (Mark 5:41)

questions.q: What was the name of the blind beggar healed near Jericho?
questions.exp: Blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging. (Mark 10:46)

questions.q: Where did Jesus send the demons called “Legion”?
questions.exp: The unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine. (Mark 5:13)

questions.q: In which town did Jesus raise a widow's only son during his funeral?
questions.exp: He went into a city called Nain… a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother. (Luke 7:11–12)

questions.q: Which servant's ear did Jesus heal in the garden when it was cut off?
questions.exp: The servant's name was Malchus. (John 18:10; healed in Luke 22:51)

questions.q: How many fish did the disciples catch when Jesus told them to cast the net on the right side after He rose?
questions.exp: Full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three. (John 21:11)

questions.q: Where did Peter find a coin to pay the temple tax?
questions.exp: When thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money. (Matthew 17:27)

questions.q: How long had the woman been sick who touched the hem of Jesus' garment?
questions.exp: A woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years. (Mark 5:25)

questions.q: How long had the man at the pool of Bethesda been sick?
questions.exp: A certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years. (John 5:5)

questions.q: How many were fed in the second feeding, with seven loaves?
questions.exp: They that had eaten were about four thousand. (Mark 8:9)

questions.q: Which tree did Jesus curse because it had no fruit?
questions.exp: He saw a fig tree… and found nothing thereon, but leaves only. (Matthew 21:19)

questions.q: In the story, who stopped to help the hurt man on the road?
questions.exp: A certain Samaritan… had compassion on him. (Luke 10:33)

questions.q: How many sheep did the shepherd leave to find the one lost sheep?
questions.exp: Doth he not leave the ninety and nine… and seeketh that which is gone astray? (Matthew 18:12)

questions.q: The wise man built his house upon the…
questions.exp: A wise man, which built his house upon a rock. (Matthew 7:24)

questions.q: What happened to the house the foolish man built on the sand?
questions.exp: It fell: and great was the fall of it. (Matthew 7:27)

questions.q: In the story of the lost son, what did the father do when his son came home?
opts: Ran and hugged him and had a party
questions.exp: His father… ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him. (Luke 15:20)

questions.q: What prayer did Jesus teach His disciples?
questions.exp: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven. (Matthew 6:9)

questions.q: Jesus said faith as small as a grain of which seed can do great things?
questions.exp: If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed. (Matthew 17:20)

questions.q: Jesus said, “Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your…”
questions.exp: That they may see your good works, and glorify your Father. (Matthew 5:16)

questions.q: Which short man climbed a tree to see Jesus?
questions.exp: He ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him. (Luke 19:4)

questions.q: What did Jesus say when His disciples tried to send children away?
opts: Suffer little children to come unto me
questions.exp: Suffer little children… to come unto me. (Matthew 19:14)

questions.q: The poor widow gave two small coins. Jesus said she gave…
questions.exp: This poor widow hath cast more in, than all they. (Mark 12:43)

questions.q: What is the greatest commandment, according to Jesus?
opts: Love the Lord thy God with all thy heart
questions.exp: This is the first and great commandment. (Matthew 22:37–38)

questions.q: In the parable of the sower, where did the seed bear good fruit?
questions.exp: Other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit. (Matthew 13:8)

questions.q: In the parable of the ten virgins, why were five foolish?
opts: They took no oil for their lamps
questions.exp: The foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them. (Matthew 25:3)

questions.q: In the parable of the talents, what did the wicked servant do with his one talent?
questions.exp: He that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money. (Matthew 25:18)

questions.q: How many times did Jesus tell Peter to forgive?
questions.exp: I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven. (Matthew 18:22)

questions.q: What are the sayings that begin “Blessed are…” in the Sermon on the Mount called?
questions.exp: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. (Matthew 5:3)

questions.q: In the story of the rich man and Lazarus, where was Lazarus carried after he died?
questions.exp: The beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom. (Luke 16:22)

questions.q: Who did Jesus say the merchant sold everything to buy?
questions.exp: When he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had. (Matthew 13:46)

questions.q: Finish the Golden Rule: “all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you…”
opts: Do ye even so to them
questions.exp: Do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets. (Matthew 7:12)

questions.q: Which two people passed by the hurt man before the Good Samaritan came?
questions.exp: A certain priest… likewise a Levite… passed by on the other side. (Luke 10:31–32)

questions.q: In the parable of the lost son, what job did he take when he ran out of money?
questions.exp: He sent him into his fields to feed swine. (Luke 15:15)

questions.q: Jesus said “I am the way, the truth, and the life”. What comes next?
opts: No man cometh unto the Father, but by me
questions.exp: No man cometh unto the Father, but by me. (John 14:6)

questions.q: What did people wave when Jesus rode into Jerusalem?
questions.exp: They took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him. (John 12:13)

questions.q: What animal did Jesus ride into Jerusalem?
questions.exp: Thy King cometh… sitting upon an ass. (Matthew 21:5)

questions.q: Which disciple betrayed Jesus?
questions.exp: Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests. (Mark 14:10)

questions.q: On which day did Jesus rise from the dead?
questions.exp: He rose again the third day according to the scriptures. (1 Corinthians 15:4)

questions.q: Who was first to see Jesus after He rose?
questions.exp: He appeared first to Mary Magdalene. (Mark 16:9)

questions.q: What special meal did Jesus share with His disciples before He died?
questions.exp: This do in remembrance of me. (Luke 22:19)

questions.q: What did Jesus wash at the Last Supper?
questions.exp: He… began to wash the disciples' feet. (John 13:5)

questions.q: How many times did Peter say he did not know Jesus?
questions.exp: Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. (Matthew 26:34)

questions.q: Which disciple would not believe until he saw Jesus' wounds?
questions.exp: Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails… I will not believe. (John 20:25)

questions.q: What was rolled in front of Jesus' tomb?
questions.exp: He rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre. (Matthew 27:60)

questions.q: Why did Jesus die on the cross?
questions.exp: Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures. (1 Corinthians 15:3)

questions.q: For how many pieces of silver did Judas betray Jesus?
questions.exp: They covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver. (Matthew 26:15)

questions.q: In which garden did Jesus pray before He was arrested?
questions.exp: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane. (Matthew 26:36)

questions.q: Which Roman governor sentenced Jesus?
questions.exp: Pilate… delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified. (Mark 15:15)

questions.q: Which prisoner did the crowd ask Pilate to release instead of Jesus?
questions.exp: They cried out all at once… release unto us Barabbas. (Luke 23:18)

questions.q: Who carried Jesus' cross part of the way?
questions.exp: A man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross. (Matthew 27:32)

questions.q: What does “Golgotha” mean?
questions.exp: Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull. (Matthew 27:33)

questions.q: Who gave his own tomb for Jesus' body?
questions.exp: Joseph of Arimathaea… laid it in his own new tomb. (Matthew 27:57–60)

questions.q: What were Jesus' last words on the cross, according to John?
opts: Today shalt thou be with me
questions.exp: He said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost. (John 19:30)

questions.q: To which village were two disciples walking when the risen Jesus joined them?
questions.exp: Two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus. (Luke 24:13)

questions.q: For how many days did the risen Jesus appear before going up to heaven?
questions.exp: Being seen of them forty days. (Acts 1:3)

questions.q: Who was the high priest when Jesus was tried?
questions.exp: They led him away to Caiaphas the high priest. (Matthew 26:57)

questions.q: What was written over the cross?
opts: Jesus of Nazareth the King of the Jews
questions.exp: JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS. (John 19:19)

questions.q: What happened to the veil of the temple when Jesus died?
opts: It fell to the ground whole
It was torn in two from top to bottom
questions.exp: The veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom. (Matthew 27:51)

questions.q: Who came upon the disciples on the day of Pentecost?
questions.exp: They were all filled with the Holy Ghost. (Acts 2:4)

questions.q: What appeared on the disciples' heads at Pentecost?
questions.exp: There appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire. (Acts 2:3)

questions.q: What was Paul's name before it was changed?
questions.exp: Saul, (who also is called Paul). (Acts 13:9)

questions.q: What happened to Saul on the road to Damascus?
opts: A bright light shone and he was blinded
questions.exp: Suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven. (Acts 9:3)

questions.q: Who freed Peter from prison in the night?
questions.exp: The angel of the Lord came upon him… and his chains fell off. (Acts 12:7)

questions.q: What were Paul and Silas doing at midnight in prison?
questions.exp: At midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God. (Acts 16:25)

questions.q: Who was the young man Paul called his son in the faith?
questions.exp: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith. (1 Timothy 1:2)

questions.q: Peter and John healed a lame man at the temple gate. What did the man do?
opts: Walked and leaped and praised God
questions.exp: He leaping up stood, and walked… walking, and leaping, and praising God. (Acts 3:8)

questions.q: Paul was shipwrecked and a snake bit him. What happened?
opts: He shook it off and was not hurt
questions.exp: He shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm. (Acts 28:5)

questions.q: Where were believers first called Christians?
questions.exp: The disciples were called Christians first in Antioch. (Acts 11:26)

questions.q: Who wrote many letters in the New Testament?
questions.exp: Paul wrote letters such as Romans, Corinthians and Galatians.

questions.q: Who was the first Christian martyr?
questions.exp: They stoned Stephen, calling upon God. (Acts 7:59)

questions.q: Who replaced Judas as the twelfth apostle?
questions.exp: The lot fell upon Matthias. (Acts 1:26)

questions.q: Which couple lied about the price of their land and died?
questions.exp: Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, and kept back part. (Acts 5:1–2)

questions.q: Whom did Philip explain Isaiah to in a chariot?
questions.exp: A man of Ethiopia, an eunuch… sitting in his chariot read Esaias. (Acts 8:27–28)

questions.q: Which Roman centurion was the first Gentile convert in Acts 10?
questions.exp: A certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion. (Acts 10:1)

questions.q: Which seller of purple cloth believed in Philippi?
questions.exp: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple. (Acts 16:14)

questions.q: Whom did Peter raise from the dead at Joppa?
questions.exp: Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes. (Acts 9:40)

questions.q: Which young man fell from a window during Paul's long sermon?
questions.exp: There sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus… and fell down. (Acts 20:9)

questions.q: Which chapter is called the “love chapter”?
questions.exp: Charity suffereth long, and is kind. (1 Corinthians 13:4)

questions.q: Which chapter is known as the “faith chapter”, listing heroes of faith?
questions.exp: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for. (Hebrews 11:1)

questions.q: Name the fruit of the Spirit that comes first in Galatians 5:22.
questions.exp: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace… (Galatians 5:22)

questions.q: On which island was John when he received the Revelation?
questions.exp: I John… was in the isle that is called Patmos. (Revelation 1:9)

questions.q: Which runaway slave did Paul send back to Philemon?
questions.exp: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus. (Philemon 1:10)

questions.q: Who was Moses' big sister who watched over him in the river?
questions.exp: His sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him. (Exodus 2:4; Miriam, Numbers 26:59)

questions.q: Which sister sat at Jesus' feet listening while Martha was busy?
questions.exp: Mary hath chosen that good part. (Luke 10:42)

questions.q: Who prayed for a baby and became the mother of Samuel?
questions.exp: For this child I prayed. (1 Samuel 1:27)

questions.q: Which woman laughed when told she would have a baby when she was very old?
questions.exp: Sarah laughed within herself. (Genesis 18:12)

questions.q: Who was the first woman in the Bible?
questions.exp: Eve was the mother of all living. (Genesis 3:20)

questions.q: Rahab helped two spies. What did she hang from her window?
questions.exp: Thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window. (Joshua 2:18)

questions.q: Which woman gave water to Abraham's servant and his camels?
questions.exp: I will draw water for thy camels also. (Genesis 24:19)

questions.q: Who was Jacob's favourite wife?
questions.exp: Jacob loved Rachel. (Genesis 29:18)

questions.q: Which kind woman made coats for the poor and was raised by Peter?
questions.exp: Shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made. (Acts 9:39)

questions.q: Who did Jesus talk with at a well in Samaria?
questions.exp: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water. (John 4:7)

questions.q: Who became queen and saved the Jewish people?
questions.exp: Esther went in unto the king to plead for her people. (Esther 8:3)

questions.q: Who was Ruth's mother-in-law?
questions.exp: Call me not Naomi, call me Mara. (Ruth 1:20)

questions.q: Which woman drove a tent peg through Sisera's head?
questions.exp: Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent. (Judges 4:21)

questions.q: Which wise woman stopped David from taking revenge on her husband Nabal?
questions.exp: Blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou. (1 Samuel 25:33)

questions.q: Who was the mother of King Solomon?
questions.exp: She bare a son, and he called his name Solomon. (2 Samuel 12:24)

questions.q: Which prophetess, aged 84, spoke of baby Jesus in the temple?
questions.exp: Anna, a prophetess… a widow of about fourscore and four years. (Luke 2:36–37)

questions.q: Which couple taught Apollos the way of God more perfectly?
questions.exp: Aquila and Priscilla… expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly. (Acts 18:26)

questions.q: Which woman anointed Jesus with costly ointment in Bethany, according to John?
questions.exp: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard. (John 12:3)

questions.q: Which servant girl was so glad to hear Peter's voice she forgot to open the gate?
questions.exp: A damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda… she opened not the gate for gladness. (Acts 12:13–14)

questions.q: Which queen refused to come when King Ahasuerus called her?
questions.exp: The queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment. (Esther 1:12)

questions.q: Which prophetess was consulted when the Book of the Law was found in Josiah's day?
questions.exp: Hilkiah the priest… went unto Huldah the prophetess. (2 Kings 22:14)

questions.q: Who was the mother of Moses?
questions.exp: Amram's wife was Jochebed… and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses. (Numbers 26:59)

questions.q: Which woman from Canaan said even the dogs eat the crumbs from the master's table?
questions.exp: Yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs. (Mark 7:26–28)

questions.q: Who said, “Let there be light”?
questions.exp: God said, Let there be light. (Genesis 1:3)

questions.q: Who said, “Let my people go”?
questions.exp: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go. (Exodus 5:1)

questions.q: Who said, “Am I my brother's keeper?”
questions.exp: Cain said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper? (Genesis 4:9)

questions.q: Who said, “Speak; for thy servant heareth”?
questions.exp: Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth. (1 Samuel 3:10)

questions.q: Who said, “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men”?
questions.exp: Jesus said, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men. (Matthew 4:19)

questions.q: Who said, “Behold the Lamb of God”?
questions.exp: John… saith, Behold the Lamb of God. (John 1:29)

questions.q: Who said, “Behold the handmaid of the Lord”?
questions.exp: Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord. (Luke 1:38)

questions.q: Who said, “Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God”?
questions.exp: Simon Peter answered… Thou art the Christ. (Matthew 16:16)

questions.q: Who said, “as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD”?
questions.exp: As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD. (Joshua 24:15)

questions.q: Who said, “Here am I; send me”?
questions.exp: Then said I, Here am I; send me. (Isaiah 6:8)

questions.q: Who said, “My Lord and my God” when he saw the risen Jesus?
questions.exp: Thomas answered… My Lord and my God. (John 20:28)

questions.q: Who said, “What is truth?”
questions.exp: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? (John 18:38)

questions.q: Who said, “He must increase, but I must decrease”?
questions.exp: He must increase, but I must decrease. (John 3:30)

questions.q: Who said, “Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian”?
questions.exp: Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian. (Acts 26:28)

questions.q: Who said, “I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course”?
questions.exp: I have fought a good fight… I have kept the faith. (2 Timothy 4:7)

questions.q: Who said, “if I perish, I perish”?
questions.exp: So will I go in unto the king… and if I perish, I perish. (Esther 4:16)

questions.q: Who said, “Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him”?
questions.exp: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him. (Job 13:15)

questions.q: Who said, “How long halt ye between two opinions?”
questions.exp: If the LORD be God, follow him. (1 Kings 18:21)

questions.q: Who said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”
questions.exp: Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved. (Acts 16:30–31)

questions.q: Who said, “Is any thing too hard for the LORD?”
questions.exp: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? (Genesis 18:14)

questions.q: Who said, “Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom”?
questions.exp: Today shalt thou be with me in paradise. (Luke 23:42–43)

questions.q: Who said, “Truly this was the Son of God”?
questions.exp: The centurion, and they that were with him… said, Truly this was the Son of God. (Matthew 27:54)

questions.q: Who said, “It is more blessed to give than to receive”, as Paul reported?
questions.exp: Remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive. (Acts 20:35)

questions.q: What is the first book of the Bible?
questions.exp: Genesis means “beginning”.

questions.q: What is the last book of the Bible?
questions.exp: Revelation closes the Bible.

questions.q: How many books are in the Bible?
questions.exp: 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament.

questions.q: What is the first book of the New Testament?
questions.exp: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John are the four Gospels.

questions.q: The first four books of the New Testament are called the…
questions.exp: Gospel means “good news”.

questions.q: How many books are in the Old Testament?
questions.exp: The Old Testament has 39 books.

questions.q: How many books are in the New Testament?
questions.exp: The New Testament has 27 books.

questions.q: Which book comes right after the four Gospels?
questions.exp: Acts of the Apostles tells how the church began.

questions.q: Which book has the story of the whale-like fish?
questions.exp: The book of Jonah.

questions.q: Which book comes after Genesis?
questions.exp: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy.

questions.q: Which book is full of songs and prayers?
questions.exp: Psalms is the Bible's song book.

questions.q: Which is the last book of the Old Testament?
questions.exp: Malachi closes the Old Testament.

questions.q: Who is traditionally believed to have written the first five books (the Pentateuch)?
questions.exp: Genesis to Deuteronomy are called the Books of Moses.

questions.q: Which Gospel writer was a doctor?
questions.exp: Luke, the beloved physician. (Colossians 4:14)

questions.q: Who wrote the book of Acts?
questions.exp: Acts is addressed to Theophilus like Luke's Gospel. (Acts 1:1; Luke 1:3)

questions.q: Which book comes right after Acts?
questions.exp: Acts, Romans, 1 Corinthians, 2 Corinthians…

questions.q: Which book is the shortest in the Old Testament?
questions.exp: Obadiah has just 21 verses.

questions.q: Which are the three “Synoptic” Gospels?
questions.exp: Synoptic means “seen together”; John's Gospel is different in style.

questions.q: Which book comes between Nehemiah and Job?
questions.exp: Ezra, Nehemiah, Esther, Job.

questions.q: How many letters (epistles) are credited to Paul in most Bibles?
questions.exp: Romans through Philemon: 13 letters (14 if Hebrews is counted).

questions.q: Which New Testament book is the shortest by number of words (in Greek)?
questions.exp: 3 John is the shortest by words; 2 John has fewer verses (13) but more words.

questions.q: Which book comes between Micah and Habakkuk?
questions.exp: Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah.

questions.q: Which Gospel begins “In the beginning was the Word”?
questions.exp: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God. (John 1:1)

questions.q: “For God so loved the…”
questions.exp: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son. (John 3:16)

questions.q: “Jesus…” (the shortest verse in the KJV)
questions.exp: Jesus wept. (John 11:35)

questions.q: “I can do all things through Christ which…”
questions.exp: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me. (Philippians 4:13)

questions.q: “Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is…”
questions.exp: For this is right. (Ephesians 6:1)

questions.q: “Be ye kind one to…”
questions.exp: Be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another. (Ephesians 4:32)

questions.q: “God is…” (1 John 4:8)
questions.exp: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love. (1 John 4:8)

questions.q: “Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not…”
questions.exp: That I might not sin against thee. (Psalm 119:11)

questions.q: “Casting all your care upon him; for he…”
questions.exp: For he careth for you. (1 Peter 5:7)

questions.q: “A new commandment I give unto you, That ye…”
questions.exp: That ye love one another; as I have loved you. (John 13:34)

questions.q: “What time I am afraid, I will…”
questions.exp: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee. (Psalm 56:3)

questions.q: “In the beginning God created the heaven and the…”
questions.exp: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. (Genesis 1:1)

questions.q: “For all have sinned, and come short of…”
questions.exp: Come short of the glory of God. (Romans 3:23)

questions.q: “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is…”
opts: Eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord
questions.exp: Eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord. (Romans 6:23)

questions.q: “For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is…”
questions.exp: It is the gift of God: Not of works, lest any man should boast. (Ephesians 2:8–9)

questions.q: “And we know that all things work together for good to them that…”
questions.exp: To them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose. (Romans 8:28)

questions.q: “If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to…”
questions.exp: To cleanse us from all unrighteousness. (1 John 1:9)

questions.q: “But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as…”
questions.exp: They shall mount up with wings as eagles. (Isaiah 40:31)

questions.q: “For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of…”
questions.exp: To give you an expected end. (Jeremiah 29:11)

questions.q: “Be still, and know that I am…”
questions.exp: Be still, and know that I am God. (Psalm 46:10)

questions.q: “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with…”
questions.exp: With thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. (Philippians 4:6)

questions.q: “Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is…”
questions.exp: He is a new creature: old things are passed away. (2 Corinthians 5:17)

questions.q: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of…”
opts: The Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost
questions.exp: The Great Commission. (Matthew 28:19)

questions.q: “Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and…”
questions.exp: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever. (Hebrews 13:8)

questions.q: Which animal spoke to Eve in the garden?
questions.exp: The serpent said unto the woman… (Genesis 3:1–4)

questions.q: Which animals did David protect his sheep from?
questions.exp: There came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock. (1 Samuel 17:34)

questions.q: Jesus said, “I am the good…” what?
questions.exp: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep. (John 10:11)

questions.q: Which bird did Noah send out first?
questions.exp: He sent forth a raven. (Genesis 8:7)

questions.q: What jumped out of the rivers in the second plague of Egypt?
questions.exp: The frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt. (Exodus 8:6)

questions.q: What insects ate all the plants in the eighth plague?
questions.exp: The locusts went up over all the land of Egypt. (Exodus 10:14)

questions.q: What did John the Baptist eat in the wilderness?
questions.exp: His meat was locusts and wild honey. (Matthew 3:4)

questions.q: Jesus is called the Lamb of God. He is also called the Lion of the tribe of…
questions.exp: The Lion of the tribe of Juda… hath prevailed. (Revelation 5:5)

questions.q: What did Samson find in the body of a lion he had killed?
questions.exp: There was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion. (Judges 14:8)

questions.q: Which birds did God send to feed Israel in the wilderness, along with manna?
questions.exp: At even the quails came up, and covered the camp. (Exodus 16:13)

questions.q: What animal crowed after Peter denied Jesus three times?
questions.exp: Immediately the cock crew. (Matthew 26:74)

questions.q: Jesus said it is easier for what animal to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom?
questions.exp: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle. (Matthew 19:24)

questions.q: How many foxes did Samson catch to burn the Philistines' fields?
questions.exp: Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. (Judges 15:4)

questions.q: What animals did Elisha's curse bring out of the woods against the youths mocking him?
questions.exp: There came forth two she bears out of the wood. (2 Kings 2:24)

questions.q: Into which animals did Jesus send the demons from the man of the Gadarenes?
questions.exp: The herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea. (Mark 5:13)

questions.q: What creature does God describe at length to Job in chapter 41?
questions.exp: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? (Job 41:1)

questions.q: Which animal did Saul's father lose, leading Saul to meet Samuel?
questions.exp: The asses of Kish Saul's father were lost. (1 Samuel 9:3)

questions.q: How many of each clean animal did Noah take into the ark?
questions.exp: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens. (Genesis 7:2)

questions.q: Which bird did Jesus say God feeds, though they neither sow nor reap, in Luke 12:24?
questions.exp: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap. (Luke 12:24)

questions.q: Which animal was the scapegoat sent into the wilderness on the Day of Atonement?
questions.exp: The goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities. (Leviticus 16:22)

questions.q: Whose blood did the Israelites put on their doorposts at Passover?
questions.exp: Your lamb shall be without blemish. (Exodus 12:5–7)

questions.q: In Revelation, what animal does Jesus ride when He returns?
questions.exp: Behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True. (Revelation 19:11)

questions.q: Which prophet's donkey saw an angel blocking the road?
questions.exp: The ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way. (Numbers 22:23)

breaks.text: Did you know? About 40 different people wrote the Bible.
breaks.answer: They wrote over roughly 1,500 years, yet it tells one story.

breaks.text: Did you know? Psalm 117 is the shortest chapter in the Bible.
breaks.answer: It has just two verses. Psalm 119, with 176 verses, is the longest.

breaks.text: Did you know? Methuselah lived 969 years!
breaks.answer: That is the longest life recorded in the Bible. (Genesis 5:27)

breaks.text: Did you know? “Jesus wept” is the shortest verse in the King James Bible.
breaks.answer: It is John 11:35, when Jesus came to Lazarus' tomb.
Matthew, Mark, Luke and John tell the good news of Jesus.

breaks.text: Did you know? Jesus spoke Aramaic.
Did you know? The Old Testament was written mostly in Hebrew.
breaks.answer: The New Testament was written in Greek.

breaks.text: Did you know? The Bible has 1,189 chapters.
breaks.answer: 929 in the Old Testament and 260 in the New Testament.

breaks.text: Did you know? Paul wrote some letters from prison.
breaks.answer: Ephesians, Philippians, Colossians and Philemon are called the prison letters.

breaks.text: Did you know? Noah's ark was about 300 cubits long.
breaks.answer: That is roughly 135 metres, longer than a football pitch! (Genesis 6:15)

breaks.text: I was inside a fish for three days and three nights. Who am I?
I wore a coat of many colours and became a ruler in Egypt. Who am I?
I spent a night with lions and woke up safe. Who am I?
I was short, so I climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus. Who am I?
I fell from the sky each morning and tasted like wafers with honey. What am I?
I was a shepherd boy who beat a giant with one stone. Who am I?
I built a huge boat before any rain came. Who am I?
I stood still in the sky so Joshua could win a battle. What am I?
